request: Only show me what y'all actually have on the shelf, not something sitting on a website somewhere (I've chased those before, and it's a long hike to nowhere). I want fall/winter clothing with a logo pattern on it, and I'll check that part myself, so don't fret. Nothing over 1065 cts, y'all (student loans ain't gonna pay themselves, and every penny counts for me). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Y'all can leave out whatever has collar crew neck, that's a dead-end trail for me. Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).
